description: MiGuOrca Stage 4：在 Stage 3 离线 Auto Bangumi 契约基础上，实现真实 Auto Bangumi HTTP client adapter、CLI 注入真实 client 的显式路径、网络错误标准化和离线可重复测试；默认流程仍不得隐式访问外部系统。

userStories.title: 定义真实 Auto Bangumi HTTP API 适配边界
userStories.description: As an integration developer, I want the real Auto Bangumi adapter boundary to be explicit so that network behavior does not leak into domain mapping or CLI confirmation logic.
acceptanceCriteria: 新增真实 AB HTTP client adapter 的模块边界和公开构造入口
adapter 实现现有 AutoBangumiClient 协议的 create_subscription(payload) 能力
adapter 只接收 AutoBangumiConfig 和 prepared payload，不直接读取 Request
adapter 不改变 Stage 3 的 submit result envelope
默认 CLI 未显式提交时不实例化真实 adapter
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 实现可注入 HTTP transport 的 AB client
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the real AB client to use an injectable transport so that network behavior can be tested without a live Auto Bangumi server.
acceptanceCriteria: HTTP transport 可在测试中替换，不要求真实网络可用
请求 endpoint 来自显式 AB config
认证 token 不进入日志、错误 details 或测试快照输出
成功 HTTP 响应转换为现有 ab_response 字典
HTTP 非成功响应转换为 Stage1Error 或兼容 ErrorResult
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 校验 AB 创建订阅请求 payload
userStories.description: As a caller, I want invalid AB payloads to fail before network submission so that predictable user errors do not become ambiguous HTTP failures.
acceptanceCriteria: 真实 client 在发送前校验 title、rss_url、save_path 和 filter_rule
缺失或类型错误返回稳定结构化错误
payload 校验不读取配置、不访问网络
校验规则与 Stage 3 payload mapper 保持兼容
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 将 CLI 显式提交路径切换为真实 AB client 注入点
userStories.description: As a CLI user, I want --submit-ab to use the configured real AB client path while keeping tests able to inject fake clients.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI 在 --submit-ab 且提供 --ab-config 时构造真实 AB client
默认生成、修改、取消和未提交路径不访问外部系统
测试仍可通过 apply_ab_submit_action 注入 FakeAutoBangumiClient
提交成功输出仍包含 top-level ab_submit_result 和 request.ab_submit_result
提交失败且 fallback_enabled 为 true 时继续输出 fallback_config
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 标准化 AB 网络异常和超时错误
userStories.description: As a user, I want connection, timeout, invalid response, and authentication failures to be reported consistently so that the fallback JSON remains actionable.
acceptanceCriteria: 连接失败、超时、非 JSON 响应、缺少订阅 ID 均映射为稳定错误类型
错误 details 不包含 token 明文
fallback_enabled 为 true 时网络失败结果包含可 JSON 序列化 fallback_config
异常处理不吞掉预期业务错误的 failed_step
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 补充真实 AB client 使用文档和示例配置
userStories.description: As an operator, I want clear documentation for configuring and running the real Auto Bangumi submission path so that secrets and fallback behavior are handled safely.
acceptanceCriteria: README 说明 AB config JSON 字段和 CLI 提交命令
示例配置不得包含真实 token
文档明确默认流程不访问外部系统
文档说明当前真实 AB API 字段仍需按部署验证
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
